issue.title: fix(hygiene): harden ignore rules, python dependencies, and audit tooling
issue.body:
Review this repository and complete the next highest-value improvement using the GitHub review baseline (Priority 3: Missing ignore rules & CI audit hygiene).

Key Changes:
- Hardened root and service .gitignore files (.venv/, venv/, .coverage, htmlcov/, .pytest_cache/, .cache/, .vite/).
- Standardized Python test dependencies in requirements-dev.txt.
- Remediated POSIX shell expansion bugs and false positives in system_audit.py and hardened_audit.py.
- Added 'test:python' script to package.json and integrated conditional execution in 'pnpm test'.
- Updated CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT.md with Python testing and audit guidelines.

issue.title: [ORG-WIDE] Protocol Handoff & Routing Layer Alignment (2026-07-15)

labels.name: enhancement
labels.description: New feature or request

issue.body:
## Summary

Cross-repo alignment following org-wide research. Conxian-Labs should own infrastructure only, not the protocol. Community should own the protocol to reduce regulatory risk.

## Strategic Direction

Per Core Directive #7: **Protocol Handoff** — The Conxian protocol/DeFi system creates regulatory risks for Conxian-Labs. **Community should own the protocol**.

## Org Repo Status (2026-07-15)

| Repo | Version | Status | Key Capabilities |
|------|---------|--------|------------------|
| `conxius-enclave-sdk` | v2.0.12 | ✅ Production | FROST DKG, BitVM2, Fedimint, Ark, MuSig2 |
| `lib-conxian-core` | v0.2.12 | ✅ Stable | Babylon/Fedimint adapters, BIP-110, Trust tiers |
| `conxian-gateway` | Active | ✅ Active | Routing middleware, ISO 20022 |
| `conxian-nexus` | Active | ✅ Active | Glass Node proof layer |
| `conxius-platform` | v0.2.5 | ✅ Active | Control plane, admin dashboard |

## Routing Layer Architecture

```
User/Protocol
     ↓
conxius-platform (control plane) ← conxian-Labs owns this
     ↓
conxian-gateway (routing) ← conxian-Labs owns this
     ↓
conxius-enclave-sdk (signing) ← conxian-Labs owns this
     ↓
Protocol (community-owned) ← Community owns this
```


## Action Items

### conxius-platform (this repo)
- [x] Core Directive #6: Routing Only
- [x] Core Directive #7: Protocol Handoff
- [ ] Update AGENTS.md with org repo status
- [ ] Define protocol handoff process

### conxian-gateway
- [ ] Verify sBTC routing integration
- [x] BIP-110 evaluation (#245)
- [ ] OP_CAT research needed

### conxius-enclave-sdk
- [x] Production ready at v2.0.12
- [ ] No action needed

### lib-conxian-core
- [x] BIP-110 alignment added
- [x] Chain adapters stable
- [ ] No action needed

### Protocol Handoff
- [ ] Define community-owned protocol structure
- [ ] Transfer DeFi contracts to community
- [ ] Update legal/regulatory docs

## Related Issues

- #1164 (revenue-automation) - spec only, community implementation
- conxian-gateway #245 (BIP-110 routing)
- conxius-enclave-sdk #179 (BIP-110 feature)

## Labels

protocol-handoff, routing-layer, org-wide, strategic

## Gateway Verification Hardening — 2026-08-07

Supporting the protocol handoff strategy, the gateway has strengthened independent verification across all settlement rails:

### Completed (PRs #325, #326)
- **9 adapter verify_state_proof implementations hardened** from rehearsal/shadow-mode to real cryptographic or structural validation
- **7 of 10 adapters** now perform real verification (Babylon EOTS, Fedimint guardian sigs, sBTC L1 proof, etc.)
- **0 TODOs** in the Rust codebase (only 1 remains: Fedimint native invite code)
- **352 tests** passing with clippy 0 warnings

### Verification Independence
The gateway can now independently verify on-chain state without trusting any single API or endpoint:
- Babylon: BIP340 Schnorr EOTS verification against finality provider keys
- Fedimint: Chaumian blind signature verification against guardian pubkeys
- sBTC: Bitcoin L1 transaction ID and block header proof-of-work verification
- Rootstock: BTC transaction SHA256d matching
- ISO 20022: pacs.008 XML generation + CAMT XSD structural validation

This reduces dependency on centralized bridge endpoints and supports the protocol handoff narrative of community-owned verification.

### Cross-repo alignment
- BitVM2 Groth16 verification: gateway boundary types ready, awaiting SDK implementation (conxius-enclave-sdk #267)
- SDK signing adapters defined in `conxian-core`, awaiting wire-up (conxius-enclave-sdk #271)

labels.name: enhancement
labels.description: New feature or request

issue.body:
## Gap
Discovered during Session 57 audit. Platform has 2 rulesets:
- `Code Quality Copilot review for default branch`: enforcement=`active` ✅
- `main`: enforcement=`evaluate` ⚠️ (warn-only)

The `main` ruleset should be `active` to enforce branch protection.

### Action
1. Audit ruleset config for all Conxian-Labs repos
2. Activate branch protection on main (require PR, require CI, block force push)
3. Document in governance KB

*This issue was created by an AI agent (OpenHands) on behalf of Conxian.*

issue.title: Stale branch review — 2026-08
issue.body:
## Stale branch review — 2026-08-01

Automated monthly branch maintenance review per [BRANCH-MAINTENANCE.md](https://github.com/Conxian/conxius-platform/blob/main/docs/BRANCH-MAINTENANCE.md).

### :wastebasket: Deletion candidates (>180 days inactive)

These branches have had no activity in over 180 days and are candidates for deletion:

- `origin` (last commit: 1970-01-01)

### Next steps

- Review each branch above and decide to **keep** (add a comment with expected timeline) or **delete**
- Delete a branch: `git push origin --delete <branch>`
- Archive before deleting: `git tag archive/<branch> origin/<branch> && git push origin --delete <branch> && git push origin archive/<branch>`

Updates `jose` from 6.2.4 to 6.2.6
Release notes

Sourced from jose's releases.

v6.2.6

Fixes

  • types: accept host CryptoKey declarations (b48a15b)

v6.2.5

Fixes

  • compare claim values for falsy validation options (eb86956)
  • forward key management parameters for a single JWE recipient (2d4f801)
  • handle a zero-length JWE additional authenticated data (16ca398)
  • reject a generateKeyPair crv option the algorithm does not imply (76364e9)
  • reject an unencoded payload in the JWS Compact Serialization (01d053f)
  • reject characters outside the Base64URL alphabet (0ebb971), references #879
  • reject duplicate "crit" values when producing (31d60e1)
  • reject invalid UTF-8 in JOSE Headers and JWT Claims Sets (5df3fed)
  • reject truncated ASN.1 key data (7a16c66)
  • surface non-ASCII token segments as JOSE errors (194fe11)
  • types: correct JWK and CryptoKey types (62a196d)
  • types: correct key resolver and JWT header types (e95f8c4)
  • validate the clockTolerance and currentDate options are finite (ab2f18d)

Documentation

  • correct subpaths and API documentation (2daec38)
  • document consumer-supplied type parameters (9e9f66c)
  • stop claiming the JWK "use" parameter is used during import (47a07b2)
  • update CHANGELOG.md (fc51bf5)

Refactor

  • assert key shape and type from the entry (971057e)
  • avoid 32-bit truncation of the AES-CBC-HMAC AAD bit length (1c8c6e9)
  • correct swapped JWE unprotected header type error messages (894c498)
  • describe each JWS algorithm once (7375028)
  • discriminate a key once (0b59a69)
  • fold single-consumer modules into their consumers (c2f0ca3)
  • generate and import keys from the entry (da69b68)
  • keep JWE out of the JWKS and embedded-JWK paths (241dd48)
  • keep JWS and JWE out of each other's bundles (2a98564)
  • parse a Protected Header in one place (30f72af)
  • resolve the content encryption algorithm once (98b50ab)
  • tighten key property checks (fe0dc3b)
  • types: add discriminated JOSE error types (f7f764e)
  • types: add JOSE identifier unions and JWK narrowing (2a20f49)
  • types: improve key and result inference (cb25e77)
  • types: trim published declaration comments (544f179)
  • unify base64 decode errors (3a91833)
  • validate each token once rather than once per layer (bbdae09)
  • write each algorithm identifier once (73d83b5)
